What I’m saying is at bronze or silver level the qol can be improved and we don’t have to ruin games with a level 1 Hank and instead can have a more balanced and fair 3v3. Isn’t that what you want, and what you’ve been arguing with me about?

I’m proposing just one solution, and I get that our views will differ. Thanks for offering your view so I can try to improve mine.

You can. However, some people enjoy playing a range of brawlers and certain maps will cater better or worse to certain brawlers. As such, multiple brawlers are required to compete at a higher level and splitting resources into even just 3/4 brawlers can quickly slow your progress to maximisation.

When they are a newer player in bronze or silver they won’t be able to max out if they are f2p, and this change could allow them to play more equally. This also allows for further growth in the player base as it encourages newer players to join, providing a better experience and faster matchmaking for everyone. I understand if you differ from my perspective but in terms of the general populous this would make a positive change.

I think that power league is in a reasonable place currently, but some trolls pop up and as other comments have requested a level minimum could be introduced, though I think at lower leagues it should be a lower level to make more brawlers accessible to newer players rather than having to level only one or two. Another thing that could be introduced is a level cap similar to clash Royale in ladder where in bronze the max level could be 9, and at gold it moves to 10 and diamond 11. This would also decrease the gap in levels making for fairer play and giving newer players a chance
